claims.value: Bodart: side A (French allied besiegers) 20,000 at investment,45,000 at the end, with 100 heavy guns; side B (Prussian-Russian garrison)16,000 with 359 guns.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "French forces 20,000 at investment and 45,000 at the siege’s end with 100 heavy guns under Marshal Lefebvre force the Prussian-Russian garrison 16,000 with 359 guns under Count Kalckreuth to surrender. The garrison receives military honours and free withdrawal on a year’s non-service undertaking."

citations.quote: Die Franzosen (zu Beginn der Einschließung 20.000 M., am Schlusse der Belagerung 45.000 M. stark mit 100 schweren Geschützen) unter Marschall Lefebvre zwingen die preußisch-russische Besatzung (16.000 M. mit 359 Geschützen) unter Gen. d. Kav. Graf Kalckreuth zur Übergabe des Platzes. Der Garnison wurde in Anerkennung ihrer tapferen Verteidigung Auszug mit allen kriegerischen Ehren und gegen die Verpflichtung, ein Jahr lang nicht gegen Frankreich oder dessen Verbündete zu dienen, freier Abzug bewilligt.

claims.value: Side A: Höpfner estimates barely 18,000 at the start of investment and 44–46,000 employed progressively during the siege.
claims.rationale: Explicit estimates at different phases, not a simultaneous engaged total. English rendering (ours): "Thus 44–46,000 men were gradually employed to capture Danzig." English rendering (ours): "Thus the 10th corps at this time can scarcely have numbered 18,000 men."

citations.quote: so daß nach und nach 44—46,000 M. zur Eroberung von Danzig verwandt wurden.
so daß das 10. Korps um diese Zeit wohl kaum 18,000 M. gezählt haben dürfte.

claims.value: Side B: Höpfner’s investment table excludes sick and wounded and totals 370 officers and 15,287 men separately across the defences.
claims.rationale: Broader defence-system table; no silent assumption that Bodart’s joint garrison or Napoleon’s Russian contingent share has identical coverage. English rendering (ours): "so the garrison at investment on 12 March, excluding sick and wounded, had the following strength:" English rendering (ours): "total 370 officers,15,287 men."

citations.quote: so daß die Garnison am 12. März bei der Einschließung, ohne Kranke und Verwundete, folgende Stärke hatte:

claims.value: Side B: Napoleon’s letter of 13 April estimates the garrison at 18,000 including 6,000 Russians.
claims.rationale: Opposing estimate at a later date; Russian contingent identity and arrival date are unresolved against Höpfner’s table. English rendering (ours): "The garrison is 18,000 men, including 6,000 Russians."

citations.quote: La garnison est de 18,000 hommes, dont 6,000 Russes.

claims.value: Kalkreuth resumed the governorship on 11 March from vice-governor Manstein; Hamberger was commandant in Höpfner.
claims.rationale: Bodart’s opening date precedes this assumption; do not assign the whole siege to the later governor without qualification. English rendering (ours): "He returned to his post on 11 March from Memel via Pillau and the spit and immediately assumed the business previously conducted by vice-governor Lieutenant-General Manstein." English rendering (ours): "Major-General Hamberger was commandant"

citations.quote: war am 11. März auf diesen seinen Posten von Memel über Pillau und die Nehrung zurückgekehrt und hatte sofort die Geschäfte übernommen, die bis dahin durch den Vice-Gouverneur, General-Lieutenant Manstein, geführt worden waren.

claims.value: The French bulletin credits Lefebvre with directing allied contingents and identifies Chasseloup/Kirgener/Lacoste as engineers and Lariboisière over artillery.
claims.rationale: Engineering names establish roles only with the page’s collective description; no independent causal credit. English rendering (ours): "Marshal Lefebvre braved everything. He inspired the Saxons, Poles and Badeners with the same spirit and led them toward his objective." English rendering (ours): "General Chasseloup, General Kirgener, Colonel Lacoste" English rendering (ours): "The whole artillery corps, commanded by General la Riboisière"

citations.quote: maréchal Lefebvre a tout bravé. Il a animé du même esprit les Saxons, les Polonais, les Badois, et les a fait marcher à son but.
